How do I get started as a Publisher? Add and verify your website(s)

A
Written by Admin
August 18, 2025

Previous step: Signing Up

To start displaying ads on your site and monetize traffic, you need to add your website(s) to our system and choose the ad format(s) you want to work with.

Click on the Sites tab in your Monetag account, select the "Add site” option, enter your website domain name, and click on the “Add site” button.

Then you will see 3 main verification options. Choose one of the following:

  • download the file and save it in the root folder of the site;

  • get a verification tag and place it in the header of the site's source code;

  • WordPress sites can be verified via our official plugin.

Option 1: Uploading a file(recommended)

While using this verification method, you need to download the sw.js file and save it in your site's root folder (a directory containing all files and subfolders).

Option 2: Insert a verification meta tag in the site's source code

Copy the verification code (meta tag) and place it between the <head> and </head> tags in your site's source code (in a website builder or code editor).

Option 3: WordPress Plugin

If your website is based on WordPress, feel free to check this manual on installing our official plugin. When it's up and running, click the "Check verification" button to link your website with the Monetag plugin and start working with ad formats.

If you run a site on Blogger or Wordpress, please click the links below for further instructions.

I have a wordpress site

I have a blogspot site


Once you've added the tag to your source code (or the HTML file has been uploaded), click on the "Verify" button. Your site should be verified within a few minutes.
